title: Wardha Scheme Of Basic Education
definition: Also known as Basic Education or Nai Talim, the Wardha Scheme was an educational plan formulated in 1937 under the guidance of Mahatma Gandhi, advocating for free, compulsory, and craft-centered primary education through the mother tongue.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern Indian History (GS-1) and Social Sector/Governance (GS-2), testing evolution of national education policy, Gandhian ideology, and self-reliance models.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Wardha Scheme Of Basic Education.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Modern Indian History
Socio-religious reform movements and Gandhian thought
